text: This report provides an update on the response to the COVID-19 pandemic as of March 2022, and responds to Board of Health direction to report back on the impact of the provincial vaccine certificate program. Multiple indicators show that the Omicron wave continues to subside in Toronto after peaking in January. While Omicron wave case counts underestimated the true number of COVID-19 cases due to provincial testing restrictions, there has been a decline in the seven-day moving average of case counts and the test positivity rate for tests that were completed. Other indicators confirm this trend. In recent weeks, there has been a decrease in new hospitalizations and intensive care admissions (ICU). Wastewater surveillance has also shown a decline in COVID-19 levels since their peak in January 2022 across most of Toronto's water treatment plants. The COVID-19 vaccine has proven effective…
